dict.string: macMCP needs your location for weather, mapping, and location tools.
macMCP needs your location for weather, mapping, and location tools.
macMCP needs access to Contacts so the LLM can search and read your address book.
macMCP needs access to Calendars so the LLM can read and manage your events.
macMCP needs access to Reminders so the LLM can read and manage your reminders.
macMCP sends Apple Events to Mail and Messages so the LLM can read, search, and send through those apps.
macMCP needs microphone access so the LLM can record audio via the capture tools.
